en: Genesis 36

p.src: 1  Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

ja: これはエサウ、すなわちエドムの
en: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
u.src: 1  Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

p.src: 2  Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

ja: ツィベオンの子アナの
en: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
u.src: 2  Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

p.src: 3  and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

ja: そしてイシュマエルの
であるバセマテである。
en: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
u.src: 3  and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

p.src: 4  Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

ja: アダはエサウにエリファズを
み、バセマテはレウエルを
en: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
u.src: 4  Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

p.src: 5  Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

ja: オホリバマはエウシュ、ヤラム、コラを
んだ。これらはカナンの
まれた息子たちである。
en: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
u.src: 5  Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

p.src: 6  Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

ja: で手に入れたすべての持ち物を
en: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
u.src: 6  Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

p.src: 7  For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

ja: らの家畜のゆえに、彼らが
えきれなかったからである。
en: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
u.src: 7  For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

p.src: 8  Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

ja: んだ。エサウはエドムである。
en: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
u.src: 8  Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

p.src: 9  This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

en: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
u.src: 9  This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

p.src: 10  these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

en: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
u.src: 10  these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

p.src: 11  The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

ja: たちは、テマン、オマル、ツェフォ、ガタム、ケナズであった。
en: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
u.src: 11  The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

p.src: 12  Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

ja: ティムナはエサウの息
エリファズのそばめであり、
はエリファズにアマレクを
んだ。これらはエサウの
en: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
u.src: 12  Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

p.src: 13  These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

ja: これらはレウエルの息
たちである。ナハテ、ゼラ、シャンマ、ミザ。これらはエサウの
en: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
u.src: 13  These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

p.src: 14  These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

ja: ツィベオンの子アナの
である、エサウの妻オホリバマの息子たちは次のとおりである。
はエサウにエウシュ、ヤラム、コラを
en: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
u.src: 14  These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

p.src: 15  These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

ja: のとおりである。エサウの
en: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
u.src: 15  These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

p.src: 16  chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

ja: アマレク。これらはエドムの
たちである。これらはアダの
en: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
u.src: 16  chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

p.src: 17  These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

ja: たちは次のとおりである。首
ミザ。これらはエドムの
たちである。これらはエサウの
en: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
u.src: 17  These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

p.src: 18  These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

ja: たちは次のとおりである。首
コラ。これらはエサウの
en: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
u.src: 18  These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

p.src: 19  These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

ja: これらがエサウ、すなわちエドムの息
en: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
u.src: 19  These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

p.src: 20  These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

ja: のとおりである。ロタン、ショバル、ツィベオン、アナ、
en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
u.src: 20  These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

p.src: 21  Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

ja: ディション、エツェル、ディシャン。これらはエドムの
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
u.src: 21  Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

p.src: 22  The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

ja: どもたちはホリとヘマムであった。ロタンの
en: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
u.src: 22  The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

p.src: 23  These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

ja: どもたちである。アルワン、マナハテ、エバル、シェフォ、オナム。
en: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
u.src: 23  These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

p.src: 24  These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

ja: これらはツィベオンの
どもたちである。アヤとアナ。
っているときに、荒野で
つけたのはこのアナである。
en: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
u.src: 24  These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

ja: 36:24 または「らば」。ヘブライ語の意味は不確かである。

p.src: 25  These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

ja: どもたちである。ディションと、アナの
en: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
u.src: 25  These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

p.src: 26  These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

ja: これらはディションの
どもたちである。ヘムダン、エシュバン、イトラン、ケラン。
en: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
u.src: 26  These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

p.src: 27  These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

ja: どもたちである。ビルハン、ザアワン、アカン。
en: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
u.src: 27  These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

p.src: 28  These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

ja: これらはディシャンの
どもたちである。ウツとアラン。
en: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
u.src: 28  These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

p.src: 29  These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

ja: たちである。首長ロタン、首
en: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
u.src: 29  These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

p.src: 30  chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

ja: ディシャン。これらはセイルの
で、それぞれの首長にしたがう、ホリ人から出た首
en: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
u.src: 30  chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

p.src: 31  These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

en: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
u.src: 31  These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

p.src: 32  Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

ja: はディンハバであった。
en: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
u.src: 32  Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

p.src: 33  Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

en: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
u.src: 33  Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

p.src: 34  Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

en: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
u.src: 34  Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

p.src: 35  Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

ja: に、モアブの野でミディアンを打ったベダデの息
en: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
u.src: 35  Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

p.src: 36  Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

ja: に、マスレカのサムラが
en: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
u.src: 36  Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

p.src: 37  Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

ja: のほとりのレホボトのシャウルが
en: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
u.src: 37  Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

p.src: 38  Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

en: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
u.src: 38  Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

p.src: 39  Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

ja: はメヘタベルといい、メザハブの娘であるマトレドの
en: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
u.src: 39  Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

p.src: 40  These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

ja: のとおりである。首長ティムナ、首
en: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
u.src: 40  These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

p.src: 41  chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

en: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
u.src: 41  chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

p.src: 42  chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

en: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
u.src: 42  chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

p.src: 43  chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

ja: イラム。これらが、彼らの所有地にある住まいにしたがうエドムの首
たちである。これがエドム
en: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
u.src: 43  chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
